raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01' to '04') in raw_customers.region, and the silver_customers step copies them through unchanged. raw_region_map gives a one-to-one code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so silver_customers should translate codes through that map, which also corrects the region labels in gold_region_daily.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON m.region_code = c.region;"}}
